Sponsor add-ons: time to build and run

For MatthewEstimates, 26 Nov 2026
How to read it
Build once is done one time and serves every sponsor after (Built = already running for Peak or Traverse). Set up is the time each new sponsor takes. Monthly is the hours per sponsor, per month, to keep it running. Price mostly on set-up plus monthly; the build is paid back over the first few sponsors.

  • Typical bundles, per sponsor: items 1, 2 and 25 (QR codes, report, member deal) take about 1¼ h to set up and 30–45 min a month. Adding the TV slides, partner spot and sponsor page (5, 6 and 7) brings it to about 3½ h to set up and 1½–2 h a month. Local search (18) adds 4–6 h to set up and 3–5 h a month.
  • A website and socials starter (3, 4, 13, 19, 21, 22): about 8–12 h to set up, then 3–5 h a month, almost all of it the monthly posts.
  • The real monthly labour is local search (18), monthly posts (22), videos (24), ads (26) and the newsletter (27). Price those by the hour. Most of the rest runs itself once it's set up.
  • * The partner spot only costs time in months when that sponsor is featured.
  • Orange notes depend on Peak's systems, so those builds could run longer once we see them. These are estimates, not quotes.
